checks: Memory-only interaction token released once; stale cleanup cannot release a later token.
Access denial/disposal clears busy state and prevents new interactions; current denied reads remain authoritative while stale success values are fenced.
Upload commits local field input before lease release, making the form dirty before deferred refresh can adopt a newer record revision.
Picker cancel/unmount/failure releases the lease; late selected bytes are zeroed and dead field lifetimes cannot upload/attach.
Record writes, view selections, runtime navigation and host Back/Forward removal guards include formBusy.
Root external URL pre/post-async checks and Discard recheck current formBusy before clearing dirty state.
Runtime snapshot retention plus stable keyed forms prevents pristine revision refresh from replacing an active image interaction.
limits: Source and pure runtime/helper/navigation tests only; no mounted browser/native picker or cross-route browser history proof.
Underlying picker/transport completion bounds remain the responsibility of existing reviewed adapters.
No persistent source, Cloud, Git or UI edits by reviewer.
